summary: FASE 2 verification (both backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_phase2.py with 23 pytest cases — 23/23 PASSED (owner-email admin promotion + subscription/status is_admin/pro, recipes real_name (19 with real_name; 'Oro di Terra'→'Pane alle Patate', 'Cuore Italiano'→'Pane Bianco Italiano'), real_name editable+persisted by admin and preserved on locked teasers, /freezer GET/PUT with low-threshold detection + emailed:true via Resend + per-user isolation + 401 for anon, /shop/products (5 products: 3 panettoni + 2 corsi, no _id), /shop/waitlist (valid ok / invalid email 422), /admin/shop/settings GET+PUT toggle persistence, /admin/shop/waitlist, 403 for non-admin, paywall regression: 2 demo recipes complete, all others locked for anon, admin sees everything). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Ricette shows real name under fancy name (IT and DE 'Kartoffelbrot'); anon paywall + paywall-preview still present on nav-tab-maestro; Home→home-section-shop opens shop-page with 5 shop-product-* cards, 'In arrivo'/'Bald verfügbar' badges, waitlist form → shop-waitlist-done; admin login → admin-panel → admin-shop card + admin-shop-toggle alternates 'In arrivo'/'Attivo' and shows waitlist count (3); admin has no paywall on Il Tuo Laboratorio, 'Scorte Freezer' opens freezer-stock, freezer-add/row inputs/freezer-low-warning ('Sotto la soglia: QA Pane Test') and freezer-save persists after reload; RecipeDialog exposes recipe-realname-input prefilled and editable, save persists (verified in list + API). Test data cleaned up (freezer rows emptied, real_name restored to 'Pane alle Patate').

minor.issue: Blocking LLM re-translation (_translate_recipe_de) on every update makes the request take 8-24s measured. Editing only 'real_name' should not trigger a full DE re-translation (real_name is not even in the translated field list); consider running it in a background task or skipping when only real_name/costing changed.

All 5 seeded image_url paths 404 (/recipes/panettone-classico.jpg, -cioccolato-e-noci, -pistacchio-e-cioccolato-bianco, panettone-mikilab.jpg, cuore-italiano.jpg). Only r_panettone_base.jpg exists in /app/frontend/public/recipes/.
The 'enabled' flag is returned by /api/shop/products but never consumed by the UI, so the admin toggle has no user-visible effect on the public Shop page.

ui_bugs.issue: No loading/pending state: after clicking Salva the dialog stays open 8-24s (slow backend PUT) with the button still enabled and no spinner/toast — user gets no feedback and can double-submit.
All product images fail to load (404) and are hidden via onError, so every card renders imageless — looks unfinished for a commercial page.

integration_issues.flow: Admin shop toggle → public Shop page
integration_issues.issue: Toggling admin-shop-toggle to 'Attivo' changes nothing on shop-page: 'In arrivo' badges and the waitlist form are rendered unconditionally (data.enabled unused in Shop.jsx).

issues: Floating Radio (left) and Parla (right) FABs overlap recipe card content — e.g. 'Filo di Francia' title and its real name are partially covered above the bottom nav; add bottom padding or offset the FABs.
Inconsistent casing in status line: 'Lista d'attesa: 3 · attivo' (lowercase) vs button label 'Attivo'; the off-state uses 'In arrivo' capitalized.
Dialog footer (Salva/Annulla) sits right over the bottom navigation bar; buttons were still clickable in tests but visually collide with the nav.

action_items: Make PUT /api/recipes/{id} fast: skip/background the DE translation when translatable fields (name/flour_type/notes/procedure) are unchanged; also translate real_name → real_name_de if that field is meant to be localized.
Add loading state (disable button + spinner) to recipe-save-btn while the PUT is in flight.
Add the 5 missing shop product images to /app/frontend/public/recipes/ (or point image_url to existing assets).
Use the shop 'enabled' flag in Shop.jsx so the admin toggle actually switches between 'In arrivo' (waitlist) and 'Attivo' (purchase/enrol) states.
Minor copy/design: unify 'attivo/Attivo' casing in AdminPanel shop card; add bottom safe padding so the Radio/Parla FABs don't cover list content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_recipe: awaiting the LLM translation inline on every recipe PUT couples a simple field edit to a 8-24s external call; wrap in asyncio background task or gate on changed translatable fields.
Shop.jsx: fetched 'enabled' state is dead code — admin toggle is effectively a no-op for end users.
server.py is 1949 lines — split into routers (auth, recipes, shop, freezer, maestro) per the >700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (with 1 HIGH UX defect on save feedback)

rca_of_the_issue: Initial 'save did not work' observation on recipe_realname was a false negative: PUT /api/recipes/{id} synchronously calls _translate_recipe_de (LLM stream) whenever name/flour_type/notes/procedure are present in the merged doc, so the response took 8s (and 24s on a second run). The frontend shows no pending state, so the dialog appeared frozen.
